enchantments.tooltip: +5 Enhancement Bonus: +5 enhancement bonus to Armor Class, attack and damage rolls.
Lifesealed +22: You are immune to magical effects that cause instant death. In addition, you have a +22% enhancement bonus to Negative Energy Absorption.
Improved Demonic Shield: Each time you are hit in melee combat there is a chance that a shield of demonic energy will grant you a +120 Profane bonus to temporary hit points.
Shield Bashing +10%: +10% Enhancement bonus to your chance of a Secondary Shield Bash. This stacks with bonuses granted by any relevant feats.
Bleeding 3: This weapon is wickedly curved, with spines and hooks meant to cause damage to those with flesh. This weapon does 3d8 bleeding damage to those that are vulnerable to it.
Shield Spikes: This effect causes this shield to do an extra 3d6 Piercing damage when it is used to shield bash.
